نصطبح (form VIII)
# نَصْطَبِحُ (naṣṭabiḥu) /nasˤ.tˤa.bi.ħu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِصْطَبَحَ (iṣṭabaḥa)
# نُصْطَبَحُ (nuṣṭabaḥu) /nusˤ.tˤa.ba.ħu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِصْطَبَحَ (iṣṭabaḥa)
# نَصْطَبِحَ (naṣṭabiḥa) /nasˤ.tˤa.bi.ħa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِصْطَبَحَ (iṣṭabaḥa)
# نُصْطَبَحَ (nuṣṭabaḥa) /nusˤ.tˤa.
